placement: V2 only: the profile text without its last paragraph (the closing line), a blank line, the filled formula text, a blank line, then the closing line. none: the profile text unchanged
rounding: fixed decimals, halves rounded up (2.25 -> 2.3); never -0.0

terms.others: the average rating other people gave this place
terms.s: the mean of your ratings of the elements in this photo

placeholders.{XHAT}: x-hat for this person and photo, decimals.xhat
placeholders.{FORMULA}: '<intercept> <sign> <|others|> × <terms.others> <sign> <|s|> × <terms.s>', each coefficient with decimals.coef, sign + or -
placeholders.{OTHERS}: the average rating other people gave this photo, decimals.others
placeholders.{S}: s: the unweighted mean of the person's A12/A13 answers for the photo's listed elements, decimals.s; if none of them is answered, the mean of all the person's A12/A13 answers
placeholders.{ELEMENTS}: the photo's listed elements, in elements.json order, their en names joined by '; '

inputs: x-hat, the coefficients and the others' average are learned from participants' answers: not exported
